name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700)

third_party_evaluations.summary: Designs and implements Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, and security.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Azure network design and hybrid connectivity at two years support an associate domain practitioner; a proctored vendor exam alone does not establish professional cross-platform network-security ownership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Azure networking, hybrid connectivity and security implementation fit associate domain work with two years of experience. The proctored vendor exam does not independently establish senior design ownership or practical troubleshooting ability.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded hybrid networking and security implementation scope fits a two-year Azure practitioner. Platform-specific proctoring does not establish broader professional network architecture or practical execution.
